_doc: AL1 classical-only gap gate (decisions.md §21). Fixed 18 Nov 2026 before any pilot run; never tuned after one. A level passes only if every criterion holds. Training seeds only.

definitions.gap_state_share: pooled over evaluated non-goal states with finite h*: share with h_max(s) < h*(s)
definitions.gap_instance_share: share of solvable instances with at least one evaluated state where h_max(s) < h*(s)
definitions.median_best_classical_ratio: median over solvable instances of min over {A*, GBFS} x {h_max, h_add, h_FF, LM-cut} of expansions / optimal plan length
definitions.solvable_share: share of generated instances that are solvable
definitions.recovery_or_revisit_plan_share: share of optimal plans that use a recovery action or revisit a host
definitions.route_change_instance_share: share of instances with any of: (a) h*_M3(s0) > h*_M0(s0); (b) recovery used; (c) revisit; (d) the M3 plan's projection is not M0-optimal
